review_comment: The parse function removes trailing semicolons from cookie strings in non-strict mode, potentially truncating legitimate cookie values that contain semicolons. This bypasses proper input validation and can lead to incorrect cookie data processing. The fix should validate that semicolons within cookie values are preserved rather than blindly removing all trailing semicolons.
